text: ECDC, 9 Nov: the DRC has 10,920 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,323 related deaths as of 8 Nov, up from 10,668 and 5,198 on 4 Nov. Eight provinces are affected and community transmission is ongoing.

judge.comment: Figures and dates come straight from the ECDC update logged in the tracker; both sets of numbers carry an as-of date and a source.

factChecks.claim: 10,920 confirmed cases in DRC as of 8 Nov
Previous figures 10,668 cases and 5,198 deaths on 4 Nov
Eight provinces affected, community transmission ongoing

text: Trump said his immigration crackdown was 'too tough' after the midterm defeat, per reporting logged 9 Nov. The tracker has ICE's detention population at 65,765, with 70.8% of detainees holding no criminal conviction.

judge.comment: The statement is in the tracker, but the tweet quotes it without the full wording or outlet. A human should check the quote and the as-of dates of the KPIs.

factChecks.claim: Trump said the crackdown was 'too tough' after a midterm defeat
70.8% of detainees with no criminal conviction

text: Saudi strikes in Sanaa province, 7-8 Nov: Houthi media first cited 11 dead and other reports at least 15. On 8 Nov the Houthis said 33 killed. Three tolls for the same strikes, none independently confirmed in the tracker.

judge.comment: The tolls match the event titles, but the 'same strikes' framing links the 7 Nov and 8 Nov events and needs a human check. Contested type never auto-approves.
